name: Ambush Runner OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-99: Blessings of the Forest

items.name: Battle Axe
items.description: These axes are designed explicitly as weapons, rather than tools. They typically weigh less, with a shaft reinforced with metal bands or bolts, and have a sharper blade, making them ideal for chopping limbs rather than wood.

items.name: Hatchet
items.description: This small axe can be used in close combat or thrown.

items.name: Padded Armor
items.description: This armor is simply a layer of heavy, quilted cloth, but it is sometimes used because it's so inexpensive. Padded armor is easier to damage and destroy than other types of armor. Heavy armor comes with a padded armor undercoat included in its Price, though it loses the comfort trait when worn under heavy armor. You can wear just that padded armor or undercoat to sleep in, if your heavy armor is destroyed, or when otherwise not wearing the full heavy armor. This allows you to keep the armor invested and benefit from the power of any runes on the associated heavy armor, but no one else can wear your heavy armor without the padded undercoat.

items.name: Climbing Kit
items.description: This satchel includes 50 feet of rope, pulleys, a dozen pitons, a hammer, a grappling hook, and one set of crampons. Climbing kits allow you to attach yourself to the wall you're Climbing, moving half as quickly as usual (minimum 5 feet) but letting you attempt a @Check[flat|dc:5] whenever you critically fail to prevent a fall. A single kit has only enough materials for one climber; each climber needs their own kit.

defensiveAbilities.name: Tandem Chop
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature or object within the ambush runner's reach is hit with a Strike by an ally using a weapon in the axe group

Requirements The ambush runner is holding a weapon in the axe group

Effect The ambush runner attempts a Strike against the same creature or object. If it hits, combine the damage with the damage from the triggering Strike for the purpose of Hardness, resistances, and weaknesses. A creature or object can only be the target of a single Tandem Chop per turn, regardless of the number of ambush runner in reach.
